question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

?, LSEO, NRDN, PQCM, RPBL
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (2) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (1) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third and fourth letters → (1) is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series

So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309284e0757b606dad9ca32208d354d308612fdf64e046211ea0847572e20478.png] 

​Hence, "**JTFP**" is the correct answer.
